description: Preferred tool for differences between two preflop or postflop contexts. The server fetches both strategies and returns action-frequency/EV deltas plus the largest postflop combo changes, avoiding two large node payloads.

anteBb.description: Requested ante in bb. nlmtt8 models a 1bb BB-ante; other positive antes return unsupported coverage.

baseline.description: The context deltas are measured from. One side of the comparison. Preflop contexts use game, stack, history and optional hand; postflop contexts use pack, board, path and optional combo.

board.description: Postflop only. Board in spaced form, e.g. "3h 3d 2s".

combo.description: Postflop only. Exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s. Provide it in both contexts or neither.

game.description: Preflop only. Both sides must name the same game.

hand.description: Preflop only. One hand or class, e.g. AKs. Provide it in both contexts or neither; PLO comparisons require it.

history.description: Preflop only. Action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ".

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

stack.description: Preflop only. Stack depth in big blinds.

comboLimit.description: Maximum largest-changing combos for aggregate postflop comparisons (default 12, maximum 50)

comparison.description: The context deltas are measured to. One side of the comparison. Preflop contexts use game, stack, history and optional hand; postflop contexts use pack, board, path and optional combo.

board.description: Postflop only. Board in spaced form, e.g. "3h 3d 2s".

combo.description: Postflop only. Exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s. Provide it in both contexts or neither.

game.description: Preflop only. Both sides must name the same game.

hand.description: Preflop only. One hand or class, e.g. AKs. Provide it in both contexts or neither; PLO comparisons require it.

history.description: Preflop only. Action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ".

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

stack.description: Preflop only. Stack depth in big blinds.

domain.description: Preflop contexts use game/stack/history/hand. Postflop contexts use pack/board/path/combo.

format.description: Requested poker format. "cash" uses the cash trees. "mtt" is supported only for preflop chip-EV against game nlmtt8; ICM, PKO, and satellite remain unsupported.

objective.description: Requested optimization objective. chip_ev is supported for nlmtt8 preflop. ICM, PKO, and satellite return unsupported coverage.

name: compare_strategies

outputSchema.description: Coverage-first envelope: coverage and context describe the answer, result carries it.

context.description: Canonical context the answer belongs to (variant, format, stacks, positions, board, path). Null when the request is unsupported.

coverage.description: Whether the request was answered exactly, aggregated, or refused as out of coverage.

analyzedBoards.description: Boards actually read at the requested path.

hasEv.description: Whether the pack ships per-combo EV.

reason.description: Why the request is out of coverage.

requested.description: The format, objective, ante, or pack that was asked for.

solveQuality.description: Published exploitability and iteration counts. Omitted, never estimated, when the pack does not publish them.

source.description: Pack, board, path, generation time, and solve quality.

status.description: "exact", "aggregated_report", or "unsupported". Treat "unsupported" as a hard stop.

unavailableAtPath.description: Selected boards with no node at the path.

result.description: Both snapshots, the per-action frequency and EV deltas, and the largest combo changes for postflop comparisons. Null when the request is unsupported.

warnings.description: Caveats that must survive into any answer built on this result.

items.description: One caveat about how the result may be used.

title: Compare two strategies
